description:
UnicoreCMS installation egg.

Automatically installs UnicoreCMS from the official GitHub repository or from a direct ZIP archive URL. The installer downloads the source, extracts it (if needed), installs all required dependencies, and prepares the CMS for use.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ "{{AUTO_REBUILD}}" == "1" ]]; then /usr/local/bin/pnpm run build; fi; if [[ "{{DATABASE_SYNC}}" == "1" ]]; then /usr/local/bin/pnpm run sync; fi; if [[ "{{DATABASE_SEED}}" == "1" ]]; then /usr/local/bin/pnpm run seed; fi; if [[ "{{DEV_MODE}}" == "1" ]]; then /usr/local/bin/pnpm run dev; else /usr/local/bin/pnpm run start; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# NodeJS App Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
export CI=true

apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip wget #libtool \
    # tini \
    # libcairo2 \
    # libpango-1.0-0 \
    # libpangocairo-1.0-0 \
    # libjpeg62-turbo \
    # libgif7 \
    # librsvg2-2

echo -e "Enabling Corepack..."
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@11.20.0 --activate

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server




if [ "${INSTALL_MODE}" == "0" ]; then
    echo -e "downloading archive skipped by INSTALL_MODE=0"
elif [ "${INSTALL_MODE}" == "1" ]; then
    
    ## add git ending if it's not on the address
    if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
        GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
    fi
    
    if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
        echo -e "using anon api call"
    else
        GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
    fi
    
    
    ## pull git js repo
    if [ "$(find /mnt/server -mindepth 1)" ]; then
        echo -e "/mnt/server directory is not empty."
        if [ -d .git ]; then
            echo -e ".git directory exists"
            if [ -f .git/config ]; then
                echo -e "loading info from git config"
                ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
            else
                echo -e "files found with no git config"
                echo -e "closing out without touching things to not break anything"
                exit 10
            fi
        fi
    
        if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
            echo "pulling latest from github"
            git pull
        fi
    else
        echo -e "/mnt/server is empty.\ncloning files into repo"
        if [ -z ${BRANCH} ]; then
            echo -e "cloning default branch"
            git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
        else
            echo -e "cloning ${BRANCH}'"
            git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
        fi
    fi
elif [ "${INSTALL_MODE}" == "2" ]; then
    DIR_COUNT=$(find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | wc -l)
    FILE_COUNT=$(find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)
    
    if [ "$DIR_COUNT" -eq 0 ] && [ "$FILE_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "Downloading server files..."
        
        wget -O UnicoreCMS.zip "${INSTALL_URL}"
        
        unzip -o UnicoreCMS.zip
        rm UnicoreCMS.zip
    else
        echo "Downloading server files skipped"
    fi
    
    #if one folder unpack then all files in folder go to upside folder
    DIR_COUNT=$(find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | wc -l)
    FILE_COUNT=$(find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)
    #echo "Directories: $DIR_COUNT"
    #echo "Files: $FILE_COUNT"
    if [ "$DIR_COUNT" -eq 1 ] && [ "$FILE_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
        DIR=$(find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d)
        echo "Moving contents of $DIR"
        shopt -s dotglob nullglob
        mv "$DIR"/* .
        shopt -u dotglob nullglob
        rmdir "$DIR"
    fi
fi
mkdir -p storage logs

echo "Installing dependencies..."

if [ -f "pnpm-lock.yaml" ]; then
    echo "from pnpm-lock.yaml..."
    /usr/local/bin/pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
else
    echo "from package.json..."
    /usr/local/bin/pnpm install
fi


if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    echo "Build project..."
    /usr/local/bin/pnpm run build
    EXIT_CODE=$?
    
    if [ "$EXIT_CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
    
        if [ "$EXIT_CODE" -eq 137 ]; then
            echo ""
            echo "=========================================="
            echo "❌ Build failed: Out of memory."
            echo ""
            echo "The build process was terminated because the container"
            echo "ran out of available RAM (Exit Code 137)."
            echo ""
            echo "Recommended memory:"
            echo "  - Minimum: 2 GB RAM"
            echo "  - Recommended: 8 GB RAM"
            echo "=========================================="
        fi
    
        exit "$EXIT_CODE"
    fi
fi

if [ ! -f "/mnt/server/.env" ] && [ -f "/mnt/server/.env.example" ]; then
    echo "Creating .env from .env.example..."
    cp /mnt/server/.env.example /mnt/server/.env
fi

echo -e "install complete"
exit 0
